title: Broward Sheriff's Office Dania Beach district page
key_finding: As of March 24, 2026, BSO operates a current Dania Beach district and says Dania Beach is served through a contractual agreement with BSO with an annual operating budget of about $19.5 million and 94 positions.

title: City of Dania Beach FY 2017 Annual Comprehensive Financial Report
key_finding: The City's FY 2017 financial statements say Dania Beach police officers became Broward Sheriff's Office employees effective October 1, 1988 under an August 30, 1988 service agreement.
